spans.text: GAURAV AGRAWAL
Bittuagarwal1213@gmail.com
Professional Summary
Seasoned Business Analyst with 5+ years of experience in Agile environments, with expertise in data-driven decision-making, process
improvements, and business requirements gathering. Strong skill set in taking complex data and converting it into actionable insights, technical
specifications, and effective dashboards. Experienced in stakeholder management, business process enhancement, and the delivery of solutions
that are aligned to strategic objectives. Committed to ongoing learning, mentorship, and driving cross-functional collaboration and Diversity &
Inclusion.
Work Experience
BUSINESS ANALYST | MASTERCARD – ETHOCA | TCS, PUNE
JUN 2025 – CURRENT
Analyzed high-volume transaction and logo datasets using SQL (Snowflake) to identify reconciliation gaps, optimize match rate performance,
and enhance overall merchant and customer experience across the network.
Led onboarding and technical integration of new merchants and logo partners, managing requirement documentation, data mapping, and
activation cycles to ensure smooth production rollout.
Led business requirement gathering sessions and documented detailed BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process flows aligned with business
objectives.
Worked across Agile SDLC, translating functional requirements into technical specifications while collaborating with engineering and QA
teams, and defining test scenarios, acceptance criteria and supporting UAT.
Applying Advanced Excel tools including Macros, Pivot Tables, and advanced formulas to streamline transaction reconciliation, improve
reporting accuracy, and support faster decision-making for match rate optimization.
BUSINESS ANALYST | JAGUAR LANDROVER LIMITED | TCS, PUNE
AUG 2021 – JUNE 2025
Led Agile ceremonies to deliver BI solutions aligned with business KPIs, improving stakeholder satisfaction by 20%.
Designed interactive Power BI dashboards using DAX measures to track KPIs and enable data-driven decision-making.
Conducted as-is/to-be analysis, EDA, impact analysis, trend analysis, gap assessments to identify root causes of mismatches, recommending
actionable improvements for reconciliation accuracy.
Collaborated with data and engineering teams to assess feasibility of analytics workloads on GCP (Big Query), supporting gap analysis and
modernization discussions.
Maintained structured assessment documentation, findings, and risk logs to support cloud migration planning and stakeholder decision
making.
Built predictive models (Regression, K-Means, ARIMA) that cut inventory stockouts by 18%.
DATA ENGINEER | JAGUAR LAND ROVER LIMITED | TCS, PUNE
JAN 2021 – AUG 2021
Employed advanced Excel to provide precise, real-time reporting to enhance data quality between departments and facilitate 20% quicker
decision-making.
Tracked system performance with Kibana, pinpointing causes of application errors and applying resolutions that minimized downtime by
Improved delivery pipelines utilizing CI/CD solutions like Jenkins and Bamboo, where Agile-based deployments are faster and release times
decrease by 25%.
Skills
Business Analysis: Requirement Gathering, BRD/FRD, User Stories, Process Mapping, Stakeholder Management
Agile & Delivery: Agile/Scrum, SDLC, Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, UAT, Acceptance Criteria
Data & Querying: SQL (Snowflake), Advanced Excel, Data Analysis, Data Validation, Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
Visualization & BI: Power BI (DAX), Tableau, Dashboard Development, KPI Reporting
Analytics & Modeling: Regression, K-Means, ARIMA, Holt-Winters, Hypothesis Testing, Exploratory Data Analysis
Platforms & Tools: GCP (BigQuery), JIRA, Confluence, Git
Education
Oxford Brookes University: Master’s in Business Analytics
APR 2024 – MAY 2025
Conducted data-driven financial and market analysis using R, identifying key drivers of stock market and company performance;
recommended high-return investments (15–20%) and evaluated WeWork’s $40B valuation drop, advising strategic cost and growth initiatives.
Developed predictive models in Python and R for electricity consumption forecasting, leveraging regression, K-Means clustering, and time
series techniques; identified Bagging Regressor as the most accurate for long-term planning.
SGBAU Amravati University: Bachelor's in computer science engineering: GPA (8.5/10; Distinction)
Jun 2016 – May 2020
Developed a healthcare app using Android Studio, SQLite, and Excel to identify cost-effective generic alternatives to prescribed medicines,
enhancing price transparency and enabling up to 60% savings for users.
Awarded the Student Prize for the outstanding research award in MSc Management and Business Analytics.
